The bug was caused by the `br` inline rule in [`src/rules.ts`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r2/work/src/rules.ts#L286), which matched only the trailing spaces or backslash and the newline (`/^( {2,}|\\)\n(?!\s*$)/`), leaving any leading spaces or tabs on the continuation line to be tokenized as leading whitespace in the following inline text token.

### Fix
Updated `br` in [`src/rules.ts`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r2/work/src/rules.ts#L286) to consume any spaces or tabs (`[ \t]*`) at the start of the continuation line following a hard line break:

```ts
const br = /^( {2,}|\\)\n(?!\s*$)[ \t]*/;
```
